ann.t: General Updates — Swan Defence and Heavy Industries Limited has submitted the Corporate Presentation on the Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026

Outcome of Board Meeting — Swan Defence and Heavy Industries Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
